name: Neon frames and lines
what: Five labels in neon on black: a glowing ring draws itself round the first label and shrinks away, a neon box rises with the next one, spins half a turn into the third, stutters and pops into the fourth in the accent colour, then drops out; finally neon lines slash across the frame round the last label's box and pull back out.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f23 the ring draws from a dot, both ends racing to meet at the top, the first label scaling and sharpening in (f11-f26); f38-f68 the ring shrinks away as a neon box rises over it (f63-f78); f91-f108 the box spins half a turn swapping to the third label; f126-f139 it stutters with an echo; f140-f150 it pops to 1.8x as the accent-colour label and settles at 0.8x; f185-f189 it drops out of the bottom; f196-f215 seven neon lines slash across, each growing from an edge, while the last box fades in (f214-f224); f266-f294 the lines retract and the box fades out

tracks.name: ring draws
tracks.what: a neon ring draws itself from a dot, both ends meeting at the top; the first label scales and sharpens in

tracks.name: ring shrinks
tracks.what: the ring and its label wander a little, then shrink away

tracks.name: box rises
tracks.what: a neon box rises from the bottom over the ring and settles, wandering slightly

tracks.name: half turn
tracks.what: the box spins half a turn on its centre and the label swaps

tracks.name: stutter
tracks.what: the box jumps about with an echo

tracks.name: pop
tracks.what: the box pops to 1.8x with the accent-colour label and settles at 0.8x

tracks.name: drop
tracks.what: the box drops out of the bottom of the frame

tracks.name: lines slash
tracks.what: seven neon lines grow across the frame, each from an edge, while the last box fades in

tracks.name: lines pull back
tracks.what: the lines retract the way they came and the box fades out
